en: A black‑and‑white image showing a large crowd of well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century fashion gathered in front of and along a long colonnaded arcade. The building is neoclassical, with repeated arches, Corinthian-style columns, ornate friezes, balustrades, and statues on the roofline. The crowd fills a promenade that runs beside the structure. There are hanging signs on the arcade and another grand building visible further along the promenade.
